name: Shark plushie
description: A stuffed cloth shark as long as a child is tall. Soft enough to sleep on.
notes: The bounding box counts the fins and tail around a round stuffed body. Comfort and morale have no content field yet.

name: Teddy bear
description: A stuffed brown bear with a red ribbon at its neck.
notes: This model draws the bear. A sitting bear with its legs out fills a fifth of its box.

name: Action figure
description: A plastic hero in a blue suit and red boots, on a round peg stand.
notes: A standing figure with arms out fills a fraction of its box.

name: Collectible knight figure
description: A painted knight in grey armour and a red cape, sword planted before him, on a black plinth with a brass plaque.
notes: Built from the small figure's shape at twice the size with a cape, sword and plinth, so the two read as one toy line. The figure and cape fill a small share of the plinth's box.

name: Yo-yo
description: A red plastic yo-yo with its string wound on.
notes: The model lays the string's tail and finger loop flat on the floor beside the yo-yo, bent towards the front, which takes the footprint to 92 by 90 mm. The loose tail and the round body leave the box mostly empty.
